content.introduction: Inflation, consumer prices for the United States (FPCPITOTLZGUSA) is the annual percentage change in the cost of a fixed basket of goods and services. The data starts from January 1960 and is sourced from the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis. As of July 2026, the latest available data is for July 2026.
